title: See your passwords and keys
consequence: It can read the stored secret for any host you can reach.

title: Manage certificates
consequence: It can replace the certificate Termix serves over HTTPS and answer domain checks from certificate authorities.

title: Run commands on your servers
consequence: Any command, on hosts you connect it to, with your access.

title: Run programs on this machine
consequence: Programs run on the Termix server itself, not on your hosts.

title: Create and change user accounts
consequence: It can add users and change their roles.

title: Act as other users
consequence: Runs background work with another user's access, such as scheduled jobs. Every use is written to the audit log.

title: Read core account tables
consequence: Can query users, roles and hosts directly from the database.

title: Handle sign in
consequence: It can add a login method, a second factor or an SSH sign-in type.

title: Set sign in rules
consequence: It can sign people out when idle, limit session length, turn off remember me and require a second factor.

title: Run sync
consequence: It can answer all sync requests, so it sees the data that devices and servers sync.

title: Choose how hosts are reached
consequence: It can carry the SSH connection to a host over its own route, so it sees everything sent to and from those hosts, passwords included.

title: Access serial and USB devices
consequence: It can open a physical serial port on the machine running Termix.

title: Receive every alert
consequence: Stores and delivers the alerts all plugins send, including their contents.

title: Replace the whole app layout
consequence: When chosen, its code draws every screen, including your terminals and settings.

title: Create and change hosts
consequence: It can add hosts and edit the ones you already have.

title: Export hosts with their secrets
consequence: Can read your hosts in full, including saved passwords and keys, and hand them out. Every export is written to the audit log.

title: Connect to your servers
consequence: It cannot see your passwords or keys.

title: Save new credentials
consequence: It can add passwords and keys to your saved credentials.

title: Reach the internet
consequence: It can send requests to outside services.

title: Accept connections
consequence: It opens a port on the Termix server.

title: Send network broadcasts
consequence: It can send packets to devices on the local network, such as a Wake-on-LAN signal.

title: Check if ports answer
consequence: Can open a plain connection to any address from the server, to see if it is reachable.

title: Provide host status
consequence: Becomes the source of the online and offline dots for every host.

title: Store recent activity
consequence: Becomes the store for the recent activity list of every user.

title: Manage hosts as read only
consequence: Hosts it manages can't be edited, deleted or reshared by anyone else.

title: See usernames and roles
consequence: Never password hashes, never two factor state.

title: Watch everything happening
consequence: Including activity from other users, not just yours.

title: Send alerts
consequence: To you or other users, and through the channels they set up.

title: Read the audit log
consequence: It can see who did what and when.

title: Open desktop windows
consequence: Only in the Termix desktop app.

title: Use this computer
consequence: Can read and change files, run a shell and open local ports on this computer. Only in the Termix desktop app.

title: See your host list
consequence: Names and addresses for hosts you can already see.

title: Store its own data
consequence: Kept in its own tables, separate from other plugins.

title: Remember small settings
consequence: Kept separate from other plugins.

title: Store its own files
consequence: In its own folder on disk, separate from other plugins.

title: Store its own secrets
consequence: Encrypted by Termix. The plugin never holds the key.

title: Read Termix settings
consequence: Server settings, not your hosts or credentials.

title: See installed plugins
consequence: It can see which plugins are installed and running.

title: Add its own screens
consequence: Tabs, panels and settings you can hide later.

title: Add color themes
consequence: Only colors and styles. No code runs for a theme.
